title: Variadic Parameters: Build a Path
hints: Inside the function, a variadic parameter is an ordinary array.
Put the logic in a `components: [String]` overload and have the variadic one forward to it.
jsBridge: A variadic `String...` combined with a defaulted `separator:` parameter after it: the label is what lets the compiler know where the variadic list ends. JS rest parameters must come last; Swift variadics needn't.

compass.q: JS rest params must be last. How can Swift put `separator:` after the variadic?
Hand-built path joining vs `URL.appending(path:)`: what does `URL` handle that string joining doesn't?
What happens with a component like `"a//b"`? Should inner slashes be collapsed?
Building API paths by string concatenation is error-prone. What would a typed `Endpoint` enum look like?

videos.title: Variadic functions – Swift in Sixty Seconds
videos.moment: Some functions are variadic, which is a fancy way of saying they accept any number of parameters of the same type.
